mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the taking of words directly from one language into another without translation."
Borrowing is the taking of words directly from one language into another without translation.

A rainy day is a terrible day therefore on which to answer the call of nature.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used when theoretical and structural elements of the source language can be transposed into the target language."
Direct Translation Techniques are used when theoretical and structural elements of the source language can be transposed into the target language.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the central character of the story."
Dan's wife is the central character of the story.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an aspect of Arabic Literature."
Arabic Prose is an aspect of Arabic Literature.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a premeditated, logical progression of events having an opening, middle, and an ending."
The plot is a premeditated, logical progression of events having an opening, middle, and an ending.

The story is known to serve as a means of entertainment and of teaching moral values to the young ones.

The short story is a kind of prose fiction, typically more compressed and passionate than the novel and the novelette (the short novel).

Poetry is the other domain and both occupy prominent positions in Arabic literature.

prose in Arabic literature is one of the means through which human experiences are depicted.
